findings.statement: The frozen oracle returned FAIL (exit 10). Meaningful-state results are overwhelmingly clean: S-A R_weak 1.144e-15, R_mass 2.965e-15, R_native 2.448e-11 <= B_native 7.788e-02 and <= 1e-10; S-C R_weak 7.355e-16, R_native 5.936e-12; the post-closure weak identity improved ~300x over the pre-closure 5e-13 class. The FAIL has two contract-design causes, not physics causes: (1) M3 froze electron mu/tau modal equality at bitwise 0.0, but the realized gaps are 2.889e-34 (S-A), 1.926e-34 (S-C), 2.190e-47 (S-B) absolute - roundoff-class, ~1e-13 relative to row scale, violating the exact-zero gate; (2) state S-B (equilibrium) is degenerate for every relative metric: the collision action is roundoff-of-zero (D_native 3.4e-29), so R_weak 1.383e-03 and R_native 1.679e-04 are ratios of noise to noise with no covariance content. All seven bound terms were measured and recorded per state; module sha verified 760a7c04; longdouble 80-bit confirmed.
